description: One of the caller's orders on XP by order_uuid (from buy_tickets or get_my_orders) -- 'did that go through?'. Returns status, fulfilment status, delivery method, in-hand date, event, seats and the all-in total in dollars. The recent list is in get_my_orders. Requires sign-in.

order_uuid.description: The order_uuid returned by buy_tickets (or listed by get_my_orders).

name: get_order_status
title: Get Order Status
